title: Coordinate expectation omits one coordinate
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and choose $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. The function obtained by averaging $f$ over the two possible values of coordinate $i$ is determined entirely by the coordinates other than $i$.
